svg.title: What happens when a student answers
svg.desc: Student speaks or types; the Next.js app sends it to the FastAPI service, which checks identity with Clerk and takes one free answer from Neon. Groq Whisper transcribes. LangGraph runs a corrector and a coach in parallel on OpenRouter models. Python guardrails check the result, Neon stores the text, Groq or DeepInfra speaks the reply, and everything streams back.
